entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns', 'Technical Support', or 'New Orders'.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, yes, I... I need to return something. I think. I'm a little confused about how it all works.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
The name is Sarah Jenkins. The order number is... V-F-7-8-8-1-2-3.
Thank you, Sarah. Let me pull that up. I see an order for a VeloSafe Pro helmet, delivered about 78 days ago. Is that the correct item?
Yes, that's the one. Is 78 days too long? The website was a bit overwhelming. The whole box is unopened, still sealed. I just don't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah, I can absolutely help you. Let me just check our policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I've confirmed it. For a standard item like this helmet, our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. You're at 78 days, so you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's great! I was so worried.
No need to worry at all. Before I process this, can I ask what the issue was? Was it the color, or did you have a concern about the safety features?
It was just the color, really. It looked different on my screen. I meant to send it back right away but I just got overwhelmed and forgot about it.

I completely understand. It's good that you called. I have processed the return authorization for you. I am emailing a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just attach that to the original box and drop it off at any UPS location. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be issued.
Wow, that was so easy. Thank you so much, Alex! You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
